scientific_role: descriptive cross-source triangulation across non-equivalent business-level and worker-level constructs

required_before_execution: The independent RPS source-rights decision must explicitly authorize retrieval/storage needed for analysis and publication of the transformed cross-source result; an unresolved permission state blocks execution.
The RPS Q2 2026 fieldwork dates must be resolved from an authoritative source if available without retrieving industry observation values; otherwise the registered May-midpoint fallback rule applies.
The BTOS comparison cycle must be selected mechanically under this protocol before its Question 7 / Answer 1 sector observations are inspected.
The selected BTOS cycle must be reproduced from the pinned official workbook with published standard errors and suppression codes preserved before any RPS values are joined.

btos.object: business-reported current Artificial Intelligence use in any business function during the last two weeks
btos.technology_scope: Artificial Intelligence as defined by BTOS

rps.object: worker-reported use of Generative AI for the respondent's job
rps.series_selection_rule: Use exactly the 20 industry rows with entity_type=industry and metric_id=adoption_work in data/registry/rps_source_series_manifest.json; do not substitute assisted-hours or reported-time-savings metrics.

non_equivalence: BTOS measures employer businesses while RPS measures workers.
BTOS current core Question 7 covers Artificial Intelligence in any business function while RPS adoption_work covers Generative AI used for a worker's job.
A common industry label does not synchronize survey universes, denominators, technology scope, or reference periods.
The comparison is not a validation of a common adoption rate and must not be converted into a composite adoption score.

period_selection.primary_rule: If authoritative Q2 2026 RPS fieldwork start and end dates are resolved before any industry observation values are retrieved, compute their calendar midpoint and select the post-2025-11-17 BTOS core cycle whose reference-period midpoint has the smallest absolute distance from that RPS midpoint. Ties select the earlier BTOS cycle. Do not choose a cycle based on estimates, suppression, sample size, correlation, or sector coverage.
period_selection.fallback_rule: If authoritative exact RPS Q2 2026 fieldwork dates remain unavailable, use 2026-05-16 as the midpoint of the named May 2026 wave and apply the same nearest-reference-midpoint rule.

fallback_selected_btos_cycle.selection_basis: date metadata only from the pinned National.xlsx workbook; Question 7 / Answer 1 sector values for this cycle were not inspected when v1 was registered

period_selection.explicit_non_selection: Do not use the already reproduced cycle 202617 for the first BTOS-RPS comparison because its late-July/early-August reference period is materially later than RPS Q2 2026.

primary.btos_requirement: published non-suppressed Question 7 / Answer 1 estimate in the mechanically selected cycle

limited_comparability_sensitivity.rule: Include every limited-comparability mapped sector that otherwise satisfies the same published/authorized/nonmissing rules; report this expanded result separately from the primary analysis.

always_excluded.reason: BTOS unclassified multi-sector businesses have no RPS target and may not be redistributed.
RPS Public Administration has no BTOS counterpart because NAICS 92 is outside the BTOS target population.

sector_eligibility.suppression_rule: If BTOS suppresses a selected-cycle sector, retain the suppression state and exclude that sector from the correlation. Never infer, complement, interpolate, or model the suppressed value and never switch cycles to recover it.
sector_eligibility.missingness_rule: If an authorized RPS sector observation is missing, exclude it pairwise under the fixed eligibility rule; do not substitute another RPS quarter or metric.

primary_statistic.name: Spearman rank correlation
primary_statistic.reason: The two sources use different units, denominators, and technology scope, so cross-sector ordering is more defensible as the primary descriptive object than level equality or a fitted slope.

secondary_statistic.name: Pearson correlation
secondary_statistic.role: descriptive sensitivity to linear association only

forbidden_statistics_or_transformations_: regression interpreted as an organizational effect
post-hoc sector deletion based on influence, sign, magnitude, or rank
analysis.insufficient_n_rule: If the primary eligible sector count is below 10, do not report either correlation as a summary association; report the preregistered analysis as insufficiently supported.

uncertainty.btos: Preserve and display published BTOS standard errors for individual sector estimates where available.
uncertainty.rps: Use only uncertainty information authorized and documented by the RPS source decision; current provider metadata does not establish a covariance matrix for the 20-industry vector.
uncertainty.cross_source_inference_v1: Do not report p-values or confidence intervals for rho or r in v1. The fixed industry taxonomy is not treated as an iid random sample of sectors, and the required cross-sector/cross-source covariance structure has not been established.
uncertainty.future_change_rule: Any inferential uncertainty model requires a new protocol version committed before computing that inference.

required_outputs: eligible-sector count and exact included sector list
excluded/suppressed/missing sector list with prespecified reason
separately labeled limited-comparability sensitivity if support is sufficient
scatter plot with axes labeled as different constructs and no identity line
BTOS question wording/reference period and RPS metric/quarter
explicit business-versus-worker and AI-versus-GenAI mismatch statement
reporting.interpretation_rule: Describe the result only as descriptive cross-industry concordance or discordance between distinct measures. Do not interpret agreement as validation or causality, and do not interpret disagreement as measurement error without separate evidence.
reporting.ranking_rule: Do not publish a one-cycle industry leaderboard from this triangulation.

pre_analysis_exposure.disclosure: During metadata verification on 2026-09-02, web search results inadvertently surfaced observation tables for two RPS industry series: Information and Management of Companies and Enterprises. No complete RPS industry vector was assembled, no candidate-cycle BTOS sector observations were inspected, and no cross-source statistic or ranking was computed before this protocol was registered.
pre_analysis_exposure.governance_rule: Do not exclude or specially treat the exposed industries because of this exposure; they remain subject to the same prespecified eligibility rules as every other sector. Describe v1 as registered with disclosed limited pre-analysis exposure, not as fully blinded.

versioning.immutable_after_values_rule: After authorized RPS industry observations or selected-cycle BTOS sector observations are inspected, changes to period selection, metrics, sector eligibility, minimum n, statistics, weighting, suppression treatment, or interpretation rules require a new protocol version with an explicit reason. Do not overwrite v1.
